correctness.rationale: For ULC interval-support (a_n), c_n=n!a_n is log-concave. Majorization of indices establishes c_{mk+j}c_{mk+l}≥c_{m(k-1)+j}c_{m(k+1)+l}. Exact factorial ratios establish (k!/(mk+j)!)(k!/(mk+l)!)≥((k−1)!/(m(k−1)+j)!)((k+1)!/(m(k+1)+l)!), with equality worst-case at j=m−1, l=0. Multiplying and summing over residue pairs yields ULC for the coarsened pmf. Interval support and strict factorial comparison establish strictness for m≥2 at interior coarse blocks. Poisson-process grouping and the decreasing ratio covariance identity imply strict underdispersion of Erlang counts. Actual extracted standalone verifier performs exact rational sampled checks; no finite test is treated as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Equal-width binning is a natural count-observation and renewal-process operation. The universal closure theorem covers all ULC discrete laws and every positive block width and proves strictness, much more than checking a specialized table. No unrelated general theorem or paper-length impact is claimed.
